scripts.build: pnpm -F @shortlink/api run build && pnpm -F @shortlink/web run build
scripts.lint: pnpm -F @shortlink/api run lint && pnpm -F @shortlink/web run lint
scripts.gen: pnpm -F @shortlink/api run gen && pnpm -F @shortlink/web run gen
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm gen && git diff --exit-code -- apps/api/openapi/openapi.yaml apps/web/shared/types/api.d.ts
